label: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE (Fixture Co): boundary case. A digital-productivity objective where speed is part of the construct, so a time limit is not a barrier.

objectives.text: Enter the week's store sales into the sheet accurately at a steady pace.
objectives.construct: keyboarding and data-entry fluency: accuracy and speed

tasks.prompt: Type the nine sales rows from the printed sheet into the store file. Work for five minutes. Check each row before you move on.

rubric.criterion: Accurate rows entered in five minutes
rubric.scoring_rationale: Speed and accuracy are both the construct; accommodation plans that extend time still apply and are scored against the plan.
